item.title: Premium Candle Product Shot

turns.text: Make a product shot of a scented candle. Make it look premium.

item.tests: Resolves a vague premium-style brief through reasonable visual choices without unnecessary clarification.
must_haves: A candle is clearly recognizable and is the dominant subject.
The candle and its container have clean, well-defined edges without obvious distortions.
The composition is uncluttered, with no distracting household objects.
Controlled lighting and a coordinated background present the candle as a polished retail product.

style.prompt: Premium editorial product photograph of a scented candle, hero product shot. A single elegant ivory ceramic candle vessel with creamy wax and a small steady flame, unbranded and without lettering, on a pale travertine plinth. A matching ceramic lid rests beside the vessel. Warm ivory and champagne palette, subtle natural stone textures, dramatic soft directional studio light, refined shadows, delicate highlights on ceramic, understated luxury fragrance campaign aesthetic. Meticulously styled, photorealistic wax and materials, crisp product detail, shallow depth of field, restrained composition with generous negative space in a wide landscape frame. No text, no logos, no watermark.
